scope: Targeted search, not an exhaustive systematic review or preregistration.
selection_basis: Source tissue, controls, assay, units and file identity; no model selected on correlation with baseline.

title: Dynamic transcriptome profiles within spermatogonial and spermatocyte populations during postnatal testis maturation revealed by single-cell sequencing

title: Regulation of meiotic progression by Sertoli-cell androgen signaling

title: The role of MEIOC at the transition from mitosis to meiosis during mammalian spermatogenesis
